I'm passing on the rest of the watchlist for now: Cloudflare and Atlassian both report earnings tomorrow so I'm respecting the pre-earnings quiet period, and names like Snowflake and SentinelOne look stretched -- very overbought, with insiders selling or big investors net sellers into the rally -- without a strong enough reason to chase them today. The one thing that would change my mind on DexCom: inventory has been building faster than sales the last few quarters, so if that turns out to mean the new product isn't selling through as fast as hoped, I'll cut it loose at the stop.
